objective: fixed-path fee vs drawdown audit: same actual target/flag path, does fee re-settlement make the 22% emergency DD condition true, and is market loss alone sufficient to trigger

cases.structure: 2 windows x 2 base_controller_costs (10,25) x settlement_cost {0,10,25} = 12 prescribed-path cases
cases.per_case: from fresh cash, actual orders/fees/held weights, three ending weights

parity_requirement: each base settlement (base10 and base25) must reproduce the frozen path day-by-day (strategy_return, fees, all three ending weights), not only terminal value, before it is used
statistics: true global DD at 0/10/25 settlement (running peak retains initial 1.0)
actual emergency days where the fixed-0 path still has DD>=22%: days/share/consecutive episode dates
no false additive DD causal decomposition; no unique market-vs-fee attribution
fee cash deducted once; cost-feedback path reported separately (not called pure fee)

native.base_check: verify actual parent native evidence for ALL stages, session count, object SHA, and dailyReturns/weights agreement; not claimed as a new run
native.counterfactual_native: real Qlib native: 4 prefix(day) + 8 suffix(15min) stages, actual cash/quantity handoff
native.labelling: every case carries a source/origin stage label; do NOT say all 12 are new runs
native.risk_analysis: main risk_analysis(mode=product) on native-confirmed rows; native missing -> needs_data, never PASS

reporting: both windows and costs 0/10/25 with source fee binding
no date shrinking and no dropna
stop_rule: if ANY actual emergency day still has the fixed-0 path drawdown >= 0.22, that refutes the explanation that fees are the sole cause; report the full conditional days/share/episode. This does NOT logically assert that all fee-neutral designs are forever infeasible. Regardless of result, StepB is not authorized, no alpha and no promotion; the next mechanism must be separately pre-registered and independently verified.

funding_convention.settlement: same pre_fee_account convention; funding convention is explicit and NOT changed
funding_convention.note: the frozen source path was recorded with pre_fee_account; re-settlement uses the identical convention

development.dedup: forbidden (same-source duplicates must not be removed)

dd_definitions.drawdown_before: 1 - (pre-execution equity) / (prior running peak that includes the initial 1.0)
dd_definitions.running_peak: includes initial 1.0; first peak capital date = None (do NOT fabricate a trading day)
dd_definitions.true_max_drawdown: computed on the whole net wealth path including the initial 1.0
dd_definitions.emergency_threshold: 0.22 is the old controller emergency_drawdown ASSUMPTION, NOT a user-explicit risk budget

tests: 0-fit patch covers the full workflow run
different-fee changing the path is NOT mistaken for same-path
base parity is actually executed and tampering is blocked
drawdown_before / peak uses the initial 1.0 and first capital date is None

recorder.large_daily: fee/nav/dd/peak/weights/episode entries saved in the Recorder
recorder.root: only small aggregates (summary, workflow.yaml, artifact_policy, Chinese conclusion)
